title: Chain turntable: Total receipt
topics: Linked lists, binary trees and search trees
summary: Reverse the links of the supplied acyclic linked list, then traverse the reversed list to produce its values. An empty head produces no values. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.
descriptionMd:
The repair bench must reverse a linked chain of labels without dropping the unvisited tail. Tomas is closing the print-room account before the afternoon mail. A single total must replace the pile of working slips.

Reverse the links of the supplied acyclic linked list, then traverse the reversed list to produce its values. An empty head produces no values.

Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement chainTurntableTotalReceipt(head, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Linked pointer reversal. Reverse the links of the supplied acyclic linked list, then traverse the reversed list to produce its values. An empty head produces no values. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.
Lists are acyclic. Trees use level-order JSON with null for missing children; [] is an empty root. The runner supplies nodes with val/next or val/left/right.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.

referenceSolutions.python:
def chainTurntableTotalReceipt(head, k):
    a=head
    out=[]
    previous=None
    node=a
    while node:
        next_node=node.next
        node.next=previous
        previous=node
        node=next_node
    node=previous
    while node:
        out.append(node.val)
        node=node.next
    return sum(out)
